verdict.rationale: Hightouch's own documented architecture keeps customer data in the customer's warehouse rather than copying it into Hightouch. Events data is also written to the customer's warehouse. A community comment adds that out of the box nothing is stored in Hightouch, only in the customer's own warehouse or S3 bucket. In practice, users decide where their data lives by choosing their own warehouse and region. missing for 10: an explicit region or data-residency selection for the Hightouch workspace or control plane (e.g. US/EU hosting), documented residency or compliance commitments, and independent hands-on corroboration.
